```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggpubr)
library(stringr)
library(RColorBrewer)

```

```{r}
###Import data
Moisture <- read.csv("~/Documents/DeQueen_Litter/Moisture.csv")
Temporal.mortality <- read.csv("~/Documents/DeQueen_Litter/Temporal.mortality.csv")
Cumulative.mortality <- read.csv("~/Documents/DeQueen_Litter/Cumulative.mortality.csv")
Temporal.mortality.growout.4 <- read.csv("~/Documents/DeQueen_Litter/Temporal.mortality.growout.4.csv")
Cumulative.mortality.baseline <- read.csv("~/Documents/DeQueen_Litter/Cumulative.mortality.baseline.csv")

```

```{r}
##Let's start with moisture
##We will first summarize mean + SEM
summary_df_moisture <- Moisture %>%
  group_by(Growout, Treatment) %>%
  summarise(
    Mean = mean(Level, na.rm = TRUE),
    SEM = sd(Level, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n())
  )

Moisture$Growout <- factor(Moisture$Growout, levels = c("Pre-treatment", "1", "2", "3"))

##Visualization 1
# Calculate mean of Level for each combination of Growout and Treatment for plotting the lines
means <- Moisture %>%
  group_by(Growout, Treatment) %>%
  summarise(Mean = mean(Level), .groups = 'drop')

# Create the plot
ggplot(Moisture, aes(x = Growout, y = Level, fill = Treatment)) +
  geom_col(aes(y = 0), alpha = 0, width = 1) +  # Temporary invisible layer for alignment
  geom_rect(aes(xmin = which(levels(as.factor(Growout)) == "1") - 0.5,
                xmax = which(levels(as.factor(Growout)) == "1") + 0.5,
                ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf), alpha = 0.5, fill = "lightgray") +
  geom_rect(aes(xmin = which(levels(as.factor(Growout)) == "3") - 0.5,
                xmax = which(levels(as.factor(Growout)) == "3") + 0.5,
                ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf), alpha = 0.5, fill = "lightgray") +
  geom_boxplot(color = 'black', alpha = 0.5) +
  #geom_violin() +
  geom_point(shape = 21, color = 'black', position = position_dodge(width = 0.75), alpha = 0.7, show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_line(data = means, aes(x = Growout, y = Mean, group = Treatment, color = Treatment), position = position_dodge(width = 0.75), show.legend = FALSE) +
  stat_summary(fun.y = "mean", geom = "point", size = 4,
               position = position_dodge(width = 0.75), color = "black", shape = 3, show.legend = FALSE) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12, color = 'black'),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12, color = 'black'),
        axis.title.x = element_text(size = 14, face = 'bold', color = 'black'),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 14, face = 'bold', color = 'black'),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 12, face = 'bold'),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 10), 
        legend.position = 'top',
        legend.background = element_rect(fill = NA)) +
  labs(y = "Moisture (%)")

ggsave("Moisture_1.png", width = 6, height = 3.5, units = "in", dpi = 900)

```

```{r}
##Let's run the statistics add add to the polished plot

##Rename Pretreatment to Baseline
Moisture <- Moisture %>%
  mutate(Growout = recode(Growout, `Pre-treatment` = "Baseline"))

##Let's start with the baseline
Moisture.baseline <- Moisture %>%
  filter(Growout == "Baseline")

# Perform a t-test to compare the means of Level between Treatment groups IndigoLT and Control
t.test.moisture.baseline <- t.test(Level ~ Treatment, data = Moisture.baseline)

##Now, for the remaining growouts
Moisture.real <- Moisture %>%
  filter(Growout != "Baseline")


# Model with Growout as a fixed effect and its interaction with Treatment
library(lme4)
library(glmmTMB)

model <- glmmTMB(Level ~ Treatment * Growout + (1 | House), data = Moisture.real)

# Print the summary of the model to see results
summary(model)

##Let's simplify and look at the growouts independently
##Data subset for each Growout
data_growout1 <- Moisture.real[Moisture.real$Growout == "1",]
data_growout2 <- Moisture.real[Moisture.real$Growout == "2",]
data_growout3 <- Moisture.real[Moisture.real$Growout == "3",]

##Perform Shapiro-Wilk test for normality
shapiro_test_g1 <- shapiro.test(data_growout1$Level)
shapiro_test_g2 <- shapiro.test(data_growout2$Level)
shapiro_test_g3 <- shapiro.test(data_growout3$Level)

##Print the results
print("Shapiro-Wilk test results for Growout 1:")
print(shapiro_test_g1)
print("Shapiro-Wilk test results for Growout 2:")
print(shapiro_test_g2)
print("Shapiro-Wilk test results for Growout 3:")
print(shapiro_test_g3)

##Create histograms for visual inspection
ggplot(data_growout1, aes(x = Level)) + geom_histogram(bins = 10, fill = "blue", alpha = 0.7) + ggtitle("Level Distribution in Growout 1")
ggplot(data_growout2, aes(x = Level)) + geom_histogram(bins = 10, fill = "red", alpha = 0.7) + ggtitle("Level Distribution in Growout 2")
ggplot(data_growout3, aes(x = Level)) + geom_histogram(bins = 10, fill = "green", alpha = 0.7) + ggtitle("Level Distribution in Growout 3")

##Separate models for each Growout
model_growout1 <- glmmTMB(Level ~ Treatment + (1 | House), data = data_growout1)
model_growout2 <- glmmTMB(Level ~ Treatment + (1 | House), data = data_growout2)
model_growout3 <- glmmTMB(Level ~ Treatment + (1 | House), data = data_growout3)

##Print the summaries to see the results and specifically the p-values for the treatment effect in each Growout
summary(model_growout1)
summary(model_growout2)
summary(model_growout3)

##Collect p-values to add to ggplot
p_value_baseline <- t.test.moisture.baseline$p.value

##Extracting from the models (assuming z-values and corresponding p-values are available directly)
p_value_growout1 <- summary(model_growout1)$coefficients$cond["TreatmentIndigoLT", "Pr(>|z|)"]
p_value_growout2 <- summary(model_growout2)$coefficients$cond["TreatmentIndigoLT", "Pr(>|z|)"]
p_value_growout3 <- summary(model_growout3)$coefficients$cond["TreatmentIndigoLT", "Pr(>|z|)"]

##Let's assess model performance with DHARMa
###https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/DHARMa/vignettes/DHARMa.html#simulation-options
##library(DHARMa)

# Simulating and analyzing residuals for model_growout1
simulation_output_growout1 <- simulateResiduals(fittedModel = model_growout1, n = 1000, seed = 123)
plot(simulation_output_growout1)
qqnorm(simulation_output_growout1$scaledResiduals)
qqline(simulation_output_growout1$scaledResiduals, col = "steelblue", lwd = 2)
testDispersion(simulation_output_growout1)
plotResiduals(simulation_output_growout1, quantreg = TRUE)
testOutliers(simulation_output_growout1)
testQuantiles(simulation_output_growout1)

# Simulating and analyzing residuals for model_growout2
simulation_output_growout2 <- simulateResiduals(fittedModel = model_growout2, n = 1000, seed = 123)
plot(simulation_output_growout2)
qqnorm(simulation_output_growout2$scaledResiduals)
qqline(simulation_output_growout2$scaledResiduals, col = "steelblue", lwd = 2)
testDispersion(simulation_output_growout2)
plotResiduals(simulation_output_growout2, quantreg = TRUE)
testOutliers(simulation_output_growout2)
testQuantiles(simulation_output_growout2)

# Simulating and analyzing residuals for model_growout3
simulation_output_growout3 <- simulateResiduals(fittedModel = model_growout3, n = 1000, seed = 123)
plot(simulation_output_growout3)
qqnorm(simulation_output_growout3$scaledResiduals)
qqline(simulation_output_growout3$scaledResiduals, col = "steelblue", lwd = 2)
testDispersion(simulation_output_growout3)
plotResiduals(simulation_output_growout3, quantreg = TRUE)
testOutliers(simulation_output_growout3)
testQuantiles(simulation_output_growout3)


##Creating a dataframe for ggplot
p_values_df <- data.frame(
  Growout = c("Baseline", "1", "2", "3"),
  P_Value = c(p_value_baseline, p_value_growout1, p_value_growout2, p_value_growout3),
  P_Value_Label = sprintf("p = %.3f", c(p_value_baseline, p_value_growout1, p_value_growout2, p_value_growout3))
)

##Update the P_Value_Label for parse-able text in ggplot
p_values_df$P_Value_Label <- sprintf("italic(p) == %.3f", c(p_value_baseline, p_value_growout1, p_value_growout2, p_value_growout3))

##Add p-values to ggplot
ggplot(Moisture, aes(x = Growout, y = Level)) +
  geom_col(aes(y = 0), alpha = 0, width = 1) +  # Temporary invisible layer for alignment
  geom_rect(aes(xmin = which(levels(as.factor(Growout)) == "1") - 0.5,
                xmax = which(levels(as.factor(Growout)) == "1") + 0.5,
                ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf), alpha = 0.5, fill = "lightgray") +
  geom_rect(aes(xmin = which(levels(as.factor(Growout)) == "3") - 0.5,
                xmax = which(levels(as.factor(Growout)) == "3") + 0.5,
                ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf), alpha = 0.5, fill = "lightgray") +
  geom_boxplot(aes(fill = Treatment), color = 'black', alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_point(shape = 21, color = 'black', position = position_dodge(width = 0.75), alpha = 0.7, aes(fill = Treatment)) +
  geom_line(data = means, aes(x = Growout, y = Mean, group = Treatment, color = Treatment), position = position_dodge(width = 0.75), show.legend = FALSE) +
  stat_summary(fun.y = "mean", geom = "point", size = 4,
               position = position_dodge(width = 0.75), color = "black", shape = 3, show.legend = FALSE, aes(fill = Treatment)) +
  geom_text(data = p_values_df, aes(x = Growout, y = max(Moisture$Level) * 1.1, label = P_Value_Label),
            hjust = 0.5, color = "red", parse = TRUE) +  # Enable parsing for mathematical annotation
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12, color = 'black'),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12, color = 'black'),
        axis.title.x = element_text(size = 14, face = 'bold', color = 'black'),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 14, face = 'bold', color = 'black'),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 12, face = 'bold'),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 10), 
        legend.position = 'top',
        legend.background = element_rect(fill = NA)) +
  labs(y = "Moisture (%)")

```
```{r}
##For more context, let's add % change relative to the baseline for each Growout-Treatment combination

##Calculate mean Level for each combination of Treatment and Growout
mean_levels_df <- Moisture %>%
  group_by(Treatment, Growout) %>%
  summarise(Mean_Level = mean(Level, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = 'drop')

##Calculate percentage change from Baseline for each Growout and Treatment
percentage_change_df <- mean_levels_df %>%
  group_by(Treatment) %>%
  mutate(
    Baseline_Level = Mean_Level[Growout == "Baseline"],  # Get the baseline level for each treatment
    Percentage_Change = (Mean_Level - Baseline_Level) / Baseline_Level * 100
  ) %>%
  filter(Growout != "Baseline")

##Plot
# Assuming 'dodge_width' is defined
dodge_width <- 0.8

ggplot(Moisture, aes(x = Growout, y = Level)) +
  geom_col(aes(y = 0), alpha = 0, width = 1) +  # Temporary invisible layer for alignment
  geom_rect(aes(xmin = which(levels(as.factor(Growout)) == "1") - 0.5,
                xmax = which(levels(as.factor(Growout)) == "1") + 0.5,
                ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf), alpha = 0.5, fill = "gray90") +
  geom_rect(aes(xmin = which(levels(as.factor(Growout)) == "3") - 0.5,
                xmax = which(levels(as.factor(Growout)) == "3") + 0.5,
                ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf), alpha = 0.5, fill = "gray90") +
  geom_boxplot(aes(fill = Treatment), color = 'black', alpha = 0.5, position = position_dodge(width = dodge_width)) +
  geom_point(shape = 21, color = 'black', alpha = 0.7, position = position_dodge(width = dodge_width), aes(fill = Treatment)) +
  geom_line(data = means, aes(x = Growout, y = Mean, group = Treatment, color = Treatment), position = position_dodge(width = dodge_width)) +
  stat_summary(fun.y = mean, geom = "point", size = 4,
               position = position_dodge(width = dodge_width), color = "black", shape = 3, aes(fill = Treatment), show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_text(data = p_values_df, aes(x = Growout, y = max(Moisture$Level) * 1.1, label = P_Value_Label),
            hjust = 0.5, color = "black", parse = TRUE, show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_label(data = percentage_change_df, aes(x = Growout, y = min(Moisture$Level) * 0.75, label = sprintf("%.1f%%", Percentage_Change), color = Treatment),
             hjust = 0.5, position = position_dodge(width = dodge_width), fill = "white", label.size = 0.25, label.padding = unit(0.25, "lines"), label.r = unit(0.15, "lines"), show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("#002051", "#bbaf71")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#002051", "#bbaf71")) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12, color = 'black'),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12, color = 'black'),
        axis.title.x = element_text(size = 14, face = 'bold', color = 'black'),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 14, face = 'bold', color = 'black'),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 12, face = 'bold'),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 10), 
        legend.position = 'top',
        legend.background = element_rect(fill = NA)) +
  labs(y = "Moisture (%)")

ggsave("Moisture_2.png", width = 6, height = 4, units = "in", dpi = 900)

```
```{r}
##Let's create a version without the third growout
# Filter the data to exclude Growout 3
Moisture_noG3 <- subset(Moisture, Growout %in% c("1", "2", "Baseline"))

# Calculate mean Level for each combination of Treatment and Growout
mean_levels_df_noG3 <- Moisture_noG3 %>%
  group_by(Treatment, Growout) %>%
  summarise(Mean_Level = mean(Level, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = 'drop')

# Calculate percentage change from Baseline for each Growout and Treatment
percentage_change_df_noG3 <- mean_levels_df_noG3 %>%
  group_by(Treatment) %>%
  mutate(
    Baseline_Level = Mean_Level[Growout == "Baseline"],  # Get the baseline level for each treatment
    Percentage_Change = (Mean_Level - Baseline_Level) / Baseline_Level * 100
  ) %>%
  filter(Growout != "Baseline")

# Creating a dataframe for ggplot using the previously stored p-values
p_values_df_noG3 <- data.frame(
  Growout = c("1", "2", "Baseline"),
  P_Value = c(p_value_growout1, p_value_growout2, p_value_baseline),
  P_Value_Label = sprintf("p = %.3f", c(p_value_growout1, p_value_growout2, p_value_baseline))
)

# Update the P_Value_Label for parse-able text in ggplot
p_values_df_noG3$P_Value_Label <- sprintf("italic(p) == %.3f", c(p_value_growout1, p_value_growout2, p_value_baseline))

# Plot
dodge_width <- 0.8

ggplot(Moisture_noG3, aes(x = Growout, y = Level)) +
  geom_col(aes(y = 0), alpha = 0, width = 1) +  # Temporary invisible layer for alignment
  geom_rect(aes(xmin = which(levels(as.factor(Growout)) == "1") - 0.5,
                xmax = which(levels(as.factor(Growout)) == "1") + 0.5,
                ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf), alpha = 0.5, fill = "gray90") +
  geom_boxplot(aes(fill = Treatment), color = 'black', alpha = 0.9, position = position_dodge(width = dodge_width)) +
  stat_summary(
    aes(fill = Treatment),
    fun = mean,
    geom = "point",
    shape = 23,
    size = 3,
    color = "white",
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.75),
    show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_jitter(
    aes(color = Treatment),
    shape = 21,
    size = 1.25,
    alpha = 0.9,
    fill = "white",  # Point fill stays white
    position = position_jitterdodge(
      jitter.width = 0.1,
      dodge.width = 0.75
    ),
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  geom_line(data = mean_levels_df_noG3, aes(x = Growout, y = Mean_Level, group = Treatment, color = Treatment), position = position_dodge(width = dodge_width)) +
  
  geom_text(data = p_values_df_noG3, aes(x = Growout, y = max(Moisture$Level) * 1.1, label = P_Value_Label),
            hjust = 0.5, color = "black", parse = TRUE, show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_label(data = percentage_change_df_noG3, aes(x = Growout, y = min(Moisture_noG3$Level) * 0.75, label = sprintf("%.1f%%", Percentage_Change), color = Treatment),
             hjust = 0.5, position = position_dodge(width = dodge_width), fill = "white", label.size = 0.25, label.padding = unit(0.25, "lines"), label.r = unit(0.15, "lines"), show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Control" = "black", "IndigoLT" = "black")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Control" = "#f8765c", "IndigoLT" = "#221150")) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12, color = 'black'),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12, color = 'black'),
        axis.title.x = element_text(size = 14, face = 'bold', color = 'black'),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 14, face = 'bold', color = 'black'),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 12, face = 'bold'),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 10), 
        legend.position = 'top',
        legend.background = element_rect(fill = NA)) +
  labs(y = "Moisture (%)")

ggsave("Moisture_noG3.png", width = 6, height = 4, units = "in", dpi = 900)
```

```{r}
##Now we will move on to mortality

##Let's first combined Temporal mortality (3 growout during the microbiome analysis) with Temporal.mortality.growout.4 (final growout)
Temporal.mortality <- rbind(Temporal.mortality, Temporal.mortality.growout.4)


##Calculate cumulative mortality
cumulative_mortality_df <- Temporal.mortality %>%
  group_by(Growout, House) %>%
  arrange(Growout, House, Week) %>%  # Ensure the data is ordered by week
  mutate(Cumulative_Mortality = cumsum(Level)) %>%
  ungroup()

##Make Week a factor
cumulative_mortality_df <- cumulative_mortality_df %>%
  mutate(
    Week = factor(Week, levels = 1:9)  # Ensure Week is treated as a factor with levels 1 through 9
  )

##Plot

##Function to create plots for each Growout
create_plot <- function(data) {
  ggplot(data, aes(x = Week, y = Cumulative_Mortality, fill = Treatment, color = Treatment)) +
    geom_line() +  # Add line plot for each Treatment
    geom_point(shape = 21, color = 'black', size = 3) +  # Add points for each data entry
    stat_summary(fun.y = mean, geom = "point", size = 4,  # Add a point for the mean of each Treatment per week
                 color = "black", shape = 3, aes(fill = Treatment), show.legend = FALSE) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("#002051", "#bbaf71")) +  # Define custom colors for lines
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("#002051", "#bbaf71")) +  # Define custom fill colors for points and summary
    labs(x = "Week", y = "Cumulative Mortality") +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(axis.title.x = element_text(size = 12), 
          axis.title.y = element_text(size = 12))
}

##List to store plots
plots <- list()

##Generate a plot for each Growout
growouts <- unique(cumulative_mortality_df$Growout)
for (g in growouts) {
  growout_data <- filter(cumulative_mortality_df, Growout == g)
  plots[[paste("Growout", g)]] <- create_plot(growout_data)
}

##Display plots (example for Growout 1, adapt as needed or loop through to display all)
print(plots[["Growout 1"]])

```

```{r}
# Calculate mean, SEM for each Treatment, Week, and Growout
statistical_summary_df <- cumulative_mortality_df %>%
  group_by(Growout, Treatment, Week) %>%
  summarise(
    Mean_Cumulative_Mortality = mean(Cumulative_Mortality),
    SEM = sd(Cumulative_Mortality) / sqrt(n()),  # Standard Error of the Mean
    .groups = 'drop'
  )

# Function to create plots for each Growout
create_plot <- function(data, actual_data, growout_number) {
  ggplot(data, aes(x = Week, y = Mean_Cumulative_Mortality, group = Treatment, fill = Treatment, color = Treatment)) +
    geom_line() +  # Line plot for mean cumulative mortality per Treatment
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = Mean_Cumulative_Mortality - SEM, ymax = Mean_Cumulative_Mortality + SEM), width = 0.2) +  # Error bars for SEM
    geom_point(data = actual_data, aes(x = Week, y = Cumulative_Mortality, color = Treatment), shape = 21, color = 'black', size = 3) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("#bbaf71", "#002051")) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("#bbaf7170", "#00205170")) +
    labs(x = "Week", y = "Cumulative Mortality") +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12, color = 'black'),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12, color = 'black'),
        axis.title.x = element_text(size = 14, face = 'bold', color = 'black'),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 14, face = 'bold', color = 'black'),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 12, face = 'bold'),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 10), 
        legend.position = 'none')
}

# Generate a plot for each Growout
plots <- list()
for (g in unique(cumulative_mortality_df$Growout)) {
  summary_data <- filter(statistical_summary_df, Growout == g)
  actual_data <- filter(cumulative_mortality_df, Growout == g)
  plots[[paste("Growout", g)]] <- create_plot(summary_data, actual_data, g)
}

##Print plots
print(plots[["Growout 1"]])
print(plots[["Growout 2"]])
print(plots[["Growout 3"]])
print(plots[["Growout 4"]])

```

```{r}
##Let's add p-values
##Perform t-tests for each combination of Growout and Week
p_value_df <- cumulative_mortality_df %>%
  group_by(Growout, Week) %>%
  do({
    test_result <- t.test(Cumulative_Mortality ~ Treatment, data = .)
    data.frame(p_value = test_result$p.value)
  }) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    Growout = rep(unique(cumulative_mortality_df$Growout), each = 9),
    Week = rep(1:9, times = length(unique(cumulative_mortality_df$Growout)))
  )

# Calculate the maximum y-position for text placement
max_positions_df <- cumulative_mortality_df %>%
  group_by(Growout, Week) %>%
  summarise(Max_Cumulative_Mortality = max(Cumulative_Mortality), .groups = 'drop')

# Ensure Week is a factor in both dataframes
p_value_df$Week <- factor(p_value_df$Week, levels = 1:9)
max_positions_df$Week <- factor(max_positions_df$Week, levels = 1:9)

# Now perform the left join
p_value_positioned_df <- left_join(p_value_df, max_positions_df, by = c("Growout", "Week"))

# Adjust the position slightly above the maximum for visibility
p_value_positioned_df$Text_Position <- p_value_positioned_df$Max_Cumulative_Mortality * 1.1

create_plot <- function(data, actual_data, p_values, growout_number) {
  ggplot(data, aes(x = Week, y = Mean_Cumulative_Mortality, group = Treatment, fill = Treatment, color = Treatment)) +
    geom_line() +  # Line plot for mean cumulative mortality per Treatment
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = Mean_Cumulative_Mortality - SEM, ymax = Mean_Cumulative_Mortality + SEM), width = 0.2) +  # Error bars for SEM
    geom_point(data = actual_data, aes(x = Week, y = Cumulative_Mortality, color = Treatment), shape = 21, color = 'black', size = 3, alpha = 0.7) +
    geom_text(data = p_values, aes(x = Week, y = Text_Position, label = sprintf("italic(p) == %.3f", p_value)), inherit.aes = FALSE, parse = TRUE, color = "black",
              size = 3.5) +  # Make 'p' italic and ensure no inheritance of other aesthetics
    scale_color_manual(values = c("#221150", "#f8765c")) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("#22115070", "#f8765c70")) +  #"Control" = "#f8765c", "IndigoLT" = "#221150"
    labs(x = "Week", y = "Cumulative Mortality") +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12, color = 'black'),
          axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12, color = 'black'),
          axis.title.x = element_text(size = 14, face = 'bold', color = 'black'),
          axis.title.y = element_text(size = 14, face = 'bold', color = 'black'),
          legend.title = element_text(size = 12, face = 'bold'),
          legend.text = element_text(size = 10), 
          legend.position = 'none')
}


# Generate a plot for each Growout
plots <- list()
for (g in unique(cumulative_mortality_df$Growout)) {
  summary_data <- filter(statistical_summary_df, Growout == g)
  actual_data <- filter(cumulative_mortality_df, Growout == g)
  p_values_data <- filter(p_value_positioned_df, Growout == g)
  plots[[paste("Growout", g)]] <- create_plot(summary_data, actual_data, p_values_data, g)
}

##Print plots
print(plots[["Growout 1"]])
ggsave("Cumulative_Mortality_Growout1.png", width = 7, height = 4, units = "in", dpi = 900)
```

```{r}
##GLMMs
##Filter the dataframe for "with culls"
with_culls_df <- filter(Cumulative.mortality, Cull_inclusion == "with culls")

##Filter the dataframe for "without culls"
without_culls_df <- filter(Cumulative.mortality, Cull_inclusion == "without culls")

##Shapiro-Wilk test for with culls
shapiro_test_with_culls <- shapiro.test(with_culls_df$Level) ##W = 0.94615, p-value = 0.3678

##Shapiro-Wilk test for without culls
shapiro_test_without_culls <- shapiro.test(without_culls_df$Level) ##W = 0.93864, p-value = 0.2746

##Histograms
ggplot(with_culls_df, aes(x = Level)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 10, fill = "blue", alpha = 0.7) +
  ggtitle("Level Distribution for 'with culls'")

ggplot(without_culls_df, aes(x = Level)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 10, fill = "red", alpha = 0.7) +
  ggtitle("Level Distribution for 'without culls'")

##GLMMs
##With culls
model_with_culls <- glmmTMB(Level ~ Treatment + (1 | Growout), data = with_culls_df)

##Print the summaries to see the results and specifically the p-values for the treatment effect in each Growout
summary(model_with_culls)

##Extracting from the models (assuming z-values and corresponding p-values are available directly)
p_value_with_culls <- summary(model_with_culls)$coefficients$cond["TreatmentIndigoLT", "Pr(>|z|)"]

##Model performance
#https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/DHARMa/vignettes/DHARMa.html#simulation-options
# Simulating residuals using the DHARMa package
simulation_output <- simulateResiduals(fittedModel = model_with_culls, n = 1000, seed = 123)

# Plotting simulated residuals
plot(simulation_output)

# Creating a QQ plot to check for normality of residuals
qqnorm(simulation_output$scaledResiduals)
qqline(simulation_output$scaledResiduals, col = "steelblue", lwd = 2)

# Checking for overdispersion
testDispersion(simulation_output)

# Checking for uniformity of residuals - to detect issues like heteroscedasticity
plotResiduals(simulation_output, quantreg = TRUE)

# Checking for outliers
testOutliers(simulation_output)

testQuantiles(simulation_output)

###Now for without culls####
##GLMM
model_without_culls <- glmmTMB(Level ~ Treatment + (1 | Growout), data = without_culls_df)

##Print the summary to see the results, focusing on the p-values for treatment effect
summary(model_without_culls)

##Extract p-values from the model (assuming z-values and corresponding p-values are directly available)
p_value_without_culls <- summary(model_without_culls)$coefficients$cond["TreatmentIndigoLT", "Pr(>|z|)"]

##Model performance
# Simulating residuals using the DHARMa package for the model without culls
simulation_output_without_culls <- simulateResiduals(fittedModel = model_without_culls, n = 1000, seed = 123)

# Plotting simulated residuals
plot(simulation_output_without_culls)

# Creating a QQ plot to check for normality of residuals
qqnorm(simulation_output_without_culls$scaledResiduals)
qqline(simulation_output_without_culls$scaledResiduals, col = "steelblue", lwd = 2)

# Checking for overdispersion
testDispersion(simulation_output_without_culls)

# Checking for uniformity of residuals - to detect issues like heteroscedasticity
plotResiduals(simulation_output_without_culls, quantreg = TRUE)

# Checking for outliers
testOutliers(simulation_output_without_culls)

# Testing the distribution of residuals across quantiles
testQuantiles(simulation_output_without_culls)
```

```{r}
##Let's add dharma comparison for consistency
## ============================================================
## DHARMa diagnostics for cumulative mortality GLMM
## Model object: model_with_culls_updated
## Matches manuscript diagnostics: simulateResiduals (n=1000),
## testDispersion, testOutliers, testQuantiles + optional plots
## ============================================================

## Settings
n_sims <- 1000
set.seed(123)
plot_dharma <- TRUE  # set FALSE if you only want printed output

## Run DHARMa diagnostics
simres <- DHARMa::simulateResiduals(
  fittedModel = model_with_culls_updated,
  n = n_sims
)

disp   <- DHARMa::testDispersion(simres)
outs   <- DHARMa::testOutliers(simres)
quants <- DHARMa::testQuantiles(simres)

cat("\n--- DHARMa diagnostics: cumulative mortality GLMM ---\n")
cat("Model object: model_with_culls_updated\n")
cat("Simulations:", n_sims, "\n\n")

cat("Dispersion test:\n")
print(disp)
cat("\nOutlier test:\n")
print(outs)
cat("\nQuantile fit test:\n")
print(quants)

## Optional plotting
if (plot_dharma) {
  plot(simres, main = "DHARMa residual diagnostics: cumulative mortality GLMM")
}

## Optional: quick pass/fail check following manuscript criteria
acceptable <- (disp$p.value > 0.05) && (outs$p.value > 0.05) && (quants$p.value > 0.05)

cat("\nModel acceptability (per manuscript criteria):\n")
cat("Dispersion p > 0.05 AND Outliers p > 0.05 AND Quantiles p > 0.05 ?\n")
cat("ACCEPTABLE =", acceptable, "\n")


```

```{r}
# ==============================================================
# Cumulative Mortality Summary Statistics (DeQueen)
# ==============================================================

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

# ==============================================================
# 1. Per-Growout × Time: which treatment had lower mortality?
# ==============================================================

growout_comparison <- combined_cumulative_mortality %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Time, Growout, Treatment) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(Mean_Total = mean(Level, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = Treatment, values_from = Mean_Total) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Difference = Control - IndigoLT,
    Lower_In = ifelse(IndigoLT < Control, "IndigoLT",
               ifelse(IndigoLT == Control, "Tie", "Control"))
  )

cat("\n=== Per-Growout comparison ===\n")
print(growout_comparison, n = Inf)

n_lower_baseline <- sum(growout_comparison$Lower_In[growout_comparison$Time == "Baseline"] == "IndigoLT")
n_total_baseline <- sum(growout_comparison$Time == "Baseline")
n_lower_after <- sum(growout_comparison$Lower_In[growout_comparison$Time == "After"] == "IndigoLT")
n_total_after <- sum(growout_comparison$Time == "After")

cat("\nBaseline: IndigoLT lower in", n_lower_baseline, "out of", n_total_baseline, "growouts\n")
cat("After: IndigoLT lower in", n_lower_after, "out of", n_total_after, "growouts\n")

# ==============================================================
# 2. Overall difference (pooled across Time periods)
# ==============================================================

overall_total <- combined_cumulative_mortality %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Treatment) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(Total_Birds = sum(Level, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

cat("\n=== Overall total cumulative mortality ===\n")
print(overall_total)

diff_overall <- overall_total$Total_Birds[overall_total$Treatment == "Control"] -
  overall_total$Total_Birds[overall_total$Treatment == "IndigoLT"]
pct_reduction <- (diff_overall / overall_total$Total_Birds[overall_total$Treatment == "Control"]) * 100

cat("Overall difference:", diff_overall, "birds\n")
cat("Percent reduction:", round(pct_reduction, 1), "%\n")

# ==============================================================
# 3. Difference split by Time period
# ==============================================================

period_total <- combined_cumulative_mortality %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Time, Treatment) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(Total_Birds = sum(Level, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = Treatment, values_from = Total_Birds) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Difference = Control - IndigoLT,
    Pct_Reduction = round((Difference / Control) * 100, 1)
  )

cat("\n=== Total cumulative mortality by Time period ===\n")
print(period_total)

# ==============================================================
# 4. Mean ± SEM per Treatment × Time
#    Each house-growout combination is one observation
# ==============================================================

overall_summary <- combined_cumulative_mortality %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Treatment, Time) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    Mean_Total = mean(Level, na.rm = TRUE),
    SD_Total   = sd(Level, na.rm = TRUE),
    n          = dplyr::n(),
    SEM_Total  = SD_Total / sqrt(n),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

cat("\n=== Mean ± SEM cumulative mortality per house ===\n")
print(overall_summary)

# ==============================================================
# 5. Overall Mean ± SEM (pooled across Time periods)
# ==============================================================

overall_pooled <- combined_cumulative_mortality %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Treatment) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    Mean_Total = mean(Level, na.rm = TRUE),
    SD_Total   = sd(Level, na.rm = TRUE),
    n          = dplyr::n(),
    SEM_Total  = SD_Total / sqrt(n),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

cat("\n=== Overall Mean ± SEM (pooled) ===\n")
print(overall_pooled)

cat("\nSummary statistics complete.\n")
```

```{r}
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12, color = "black"),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold", color = "black"),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.position = "top"
  ) +
  labs(
    y = "Mortality",
    fill = "Treatment",
    color = "Treatment"
  )

ggsave("Mortality_plot_legend_alternative.png", width = 7, height = 4, units = "in", dpi = 900)

```
